nodes.name: CodeMapRemoval.md
nodes.summary: Architecture audit documenting the full removal of the Code Map feature (persistent symbol/dependency graph) from the Rust workspace crate, Tauri command surface, agent tool/prompt catalog, frontend UI, and storage reporting, with a ten-layer audit and verification evidence confirming no residual references and passing compilation/tests.

nodes.name: OversizedTypeScriptBreakdown.md
nodes.summary: Architecture audit recording the structural breakdown of 16 TypeScript/TSX files that exceeded 1,000 lines (e.g. GitHubWorkItemsSurface.tsx, org2CloudSyncEngine.ts, ChatView.tsx, cliAdapter.ts) into cohesive sub-modules, with an inventory table, term-overloading review, ten-layer audit, and residual-risk notes.

nodes.name: SessionTabPlacementAndTranscript.md
nodes.summary: Architecture audit of bidirectional session-tab movement between Chat Panel and My Workstation (sidebar drag/drop, context-menu transfer, single ownership invariant, imported-session continuation) and shared raw-transcript loading, extended with a shared session header menu and historical-turn projection fix, backed by a call-chain trace and ten-layer audit.

nodes.name: SharedSessionPolling.md
nodes.summary: Architecture audit diagnosing excessive Realtime-driven request fan-out in Org2Cloud/TeamCollaboration shared sessions, tracing how one coarse org_change_signals invalidation multiplies into roster, entitlement, project, comment, and task-runner reads, and documenting the client-side coalescing/deduplication fixes applied plus remaining server-side follow-ups.
